description: Shared, versioned polyphonic OMR error vocabulary for ScoreMosaic benchmark/evaluation, ST-OMR evaluation, and Correction Engine evidence exchange. Repository ownership and runtime authority boundaries remain separate.

categories.description: Incorrect written or sounding pitch identity.
Incorrect effective or written duration.
Incorrect temporal onset or event placement.
Incorrect voice identity or reassignment.
Incorrect staff identity or reassignment.
Rest presence, type, placement, or duration error.
Accidental recognition, attachment, or semantic application error.
Tie presence, direction, endpoint, or relation error.
Slur presence, endpoint, or relation error.
Tuplet membership, ratio, boundary, or relation error.
Beam presence, grouping, level, or relation error.
Stem presence, direction, attachment, or ambiguity error.
Incorrect simultaneous-note grouping or chord membership.
Cross-staff assignment or relation error.
Meter, time-signature, or measure-capacity interpretation error.
Measure boundary, numbering, implicit/pickup, or segmentation error.
Grace-note presence, ordering, attachment, or grace semantics error.
Ornament presence, type, attachment, or interpretation error.
Augmentation-dot presence, count, or attachment error.
Tablature string/fret position error when TAB evidence is in scope.
Known error that does not fit a more specific current category.
Evidence is insufficient or conflicting; no more specific error label is justified.
